patterns.note: Split-screen hero with a fixed left content column and a scroll-triggered horizontal image carousel on the right.
Hero section features a left-aligned content block that remains sticky while a sequence of full-height images on the right parallax horizontally as the user scrolls vertically.
A single vibrant pink (#f78da7) is used as the primary accent for CTAs and key highlights against a predominantly monochrome (black, white, grey) palette.
Article listings are presented in a responsive grid of cards, each featuring an image, title, and meta-information, consistently styled across multiple sections.
Large, bold sans-serif headings are paired with a clean, readable sans-serif body text, often accompanied by small, uppercase labels for categories or meta-info.

technique_notes: The site employs a custom scroll-jacking effect, likely using locomotive-scroll, to create a unique hero experience where vertical scrolling drives a horizontal parallax of full-bleed images on the right, while a content block on the left remains fixed in the viewport.
Content sections are structured with generous vertical spacing and often use full-width background images or solid color blocks to visually separate distinct themes or calls to action.
Navigation and content overview are maintained on interior pages through a sticky header and a sticky right-hand table of contents, ensuring persistent access to key information.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, legible body text and small uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for most elements including buttons, cards, and images.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; the hero section is very airy, while article grids maintain a balanced density.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the interactive hero section, which uses vertical scroll to drive a horizontal parallaxing image carousel on the right, while a fixed content block on the left provides a unique and engaging introduction.
